staff.name: Lily Liu
staff.bio: Lily Liu is a junior studying CS + Statistics at UIUC, originally from Aurora, IL. On campus, she's involved with CS SAIL, Women in Statistics, and the Alpha Omega Epsilon Engineering Sorority. Passionate about artificial intelligence, Lily previously conducted machine learning research on non-invasive endometriosis diagnosis through UCSF AI4ALL, where she also served as a Teaching Assistant mentoring students in AI projects. Beyond academics, advocates for women and nonbinary students in STEM and loves to spend a lot of time with friends and family.
